title: Semi-Automated PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol first preps one 384 well plate with lysis buffer and sample to undergo a thermocycler. In this step, samples are transferred from tube rack to the 384 well plate. If the number of samples selected exceeds the number of samples that can fit onto the deck, the protocol pauses and prompts the user to refill the tube racks with new samples up to the number of samples selected. Afterwards, 4ul of the resulting solution is transferred to the final 384 well plate. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: Select the number of samples (1-384) for this run. If larger than 90 samples are selected, the protocol will pause after the last sample is transferred on the deck and will prompt the user to refill samples up to the number specified. Samples should always be placed in the tuberack down by column, and in the order of the deck slots (i.e. 4, 5, 6 ..., etc.) * `P20/P300 Dispense Flow Rate`: Global control of P20 and P300 dispense flow rate. A value of 1.0 is default, 0.5 is 50% of the default flow rate, 1.2 is 20% faster the default flow rate, etc. * `P20 Single Mount`: Specify whether the P20 single channel pipette will be mounted on the left or right. * `P300 Single Mount`: Specify whether the P300 single channel pipette will be mounted on the left or right. ---

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the run parameters as follows: select the number of samples (1‑384); if more than 90 samples are selected, plan for a pause after the last sample on the deck to refill tube racks; set P20/P300 dispense flow rate (default 1.0, adjust as needed); specify P20 single‑channel mount (left or right); specify P300 single‑channel mount (left or right).

substeps.instruction: If >90 samples, note that the protocol will pause after the last sample on the deck and prompt for tube‑rack refill.
Set P20/P300 dispense flow rate (default 1.0; 0.5 = 50 % speed, 1.2 = 20 % faster, etc.).
Choose P20 single‑mount side (left or right).
Choose P300 single‑mount side (left or right).

steps.title: Add lysis buffer to plate 1
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 µL of lysis buffer into each designated well of 384‑well plate 1 using the same tip for all wells.

steps.title: Add sample to plate 1
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of each sample from the tube rack to the corresponding well of 384‑well plate 1 using a fresh tip for each well. Place samples in the tube rack down by column and load them onto deck slots in order (4, 5, 6,…). If more than 90 samples are selected, after the last sample on the deck the protocol pauses and prompts you to refill the tube racks with additional samples up to the total selected.

substeps.instruction: Arrange samples in the tube rack down by column and in deck slot order (4, 5, 6,…).
Using a new tip for each well, dispense 50 µL of sample into the corresponding well of plate 1.
If >90 samples, pause after the last sample on the deck and refill tube racks as prompted.

steps.title: Offline thermocycling
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and perform the required thermocycling of plate 1 offline.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to final plate
steps.instruction: Using a P20 pipette, transfer 4 µL of the resulting solution from each well of 384‑well plate 1 to the corresponding well of 384‑well plate 2.
